result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and traffic signals, but the environment suffers from faded pavement markings and narrow walkways on one side. The presence of street trees and a clear separation from traffic on the right side improves the experience, though the overall maintenance level appears low.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The transverse crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: A utility pole is located directly within the narrow sidewalk path on the left side of the image.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the street, adjacent to the brick building

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Replace faded transverse markings with continental or ladder-style high-visibility markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to reduce the pedestrian crossing distance and improve sight lines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Ensure pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers are installed and visible for all crossing directions.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, well-maintained sidewalk in front of an institutional building, identified as a public school. While the walkway is spacious and clear of obstructions, there is no physical buffer between the pedestrian area and the roadway.

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian buffer
hazards.description: There is no physical separation or buffer zone (like trees, planters, or parked cars) between the wide sidewalk and the active roadway.

hazards.name: Accessibility barrier
hazards.description: The primary entrance shown features steps without a visible adjacent ramp, which may pose a challenge for users with mobility aids.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Introduce a furniture or planting zone between the sidewalk and the curb to increase the perceived and actual safety of pedestrians from moving traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility School Zone Markings
interventions.description: Ensure the roadway adjacent to the school includes high-visibility crosswalks and school zone signage to alert drivers to the presence of children.

result.summary: The street features a paved sidewalk on the left side but lacks a formal walkway on the right, where pedestrians must navigate an unpaved, overgrown verge. There are no marked crossings or traffic calming measures visible, creating an environment that prioritizes vehicle movement over pedestrian safety.

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalk
hazards.description: The right side of the street lacks a paved walkway, forcing pedestrians to walk on an uneven dirt/grass surface or in the roadway.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: There are no visible marked crosswalks, making it difficult for pedestrians to safely cross the street.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, ADA-compliant paved sidewalk on the right side of the street to provide a safe, separated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility marked crosswalks at intersections or appropriate mid-block locations to clearly designate pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at potential crossing points to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a wide but poorly maintained sidewalk adjacent to a building with significant blank frontage and boarded-up openings. While on-street parking provides a buffer from traffic, the lack of lighting and the degraded state of the walkway reduce safety and comfort.

hazards.name: Degraded Sidewalk Surface
hazards.description: The sidewalk pavement is cracked and uneven, creating trip hazards for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Visible across the foreground and midground walkway.

hazards.name: Lack of Street Lighting
hazards.description: No street lighting is visible, which can lead to poor visibility and reduced security at night.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Reconstruction
interventions.description: Repair and level the sidewalk to ensure a safe, continuous, and ADA-compliant walking surface.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install lighting to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians during nighttime hours.
